postings.title: Venture Designer (London)
postings.description:
About Founders Factory

Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator backed by some of the world's leading corporations. We combine capital investment with deep operational expertise to build and scale tech companies from scratch. With a portfolio of over 300 companies and $900M+ in follow-on funding, we offer a unique opportunity to shape the future of tech and entrepreneurship - working at the intersection of corporate innovation and startup building.

About the Role

Venture Design at Founders Factory is how we create new venture concepts on demand, not by chance. Working closely with our corporate partners, you'll take high-level investment themes and turn them into validated, venture-backable concepts through a structured three-month sprint.

This is the earliest and most exploratory stage of our venture building process. You'll dig into markets, uncover gaps, conceptualise solutions, and pressure-test them with real users -  all before a founder is ever hired. The concepts you validate and present to our Investment Committee become the ventures we go on to build. It's high-impact, high-autonomy work that directly shapes our portfolio.



What You'll Do

You'll own the end-to-end venture design sprint, working across research, strategy, prototyping, and validation. Specifically, you will:

 - Take investment themes developed with our corporate partners and break them down into explorable problem spaces and opportunity areas.

 - Conduct deep market research to understand where sectors are heading, identify structural gaps, and map the competitive landscape.

 - Generate multiple potential venture concepts from each theme, applying human-centred design principles to conceptualise solutions that address real user needs.

 - Design and run rapid experiments — including A/B testing, prototype testing, and user interviews — to validate or kill concepts quickly.

 - Synthesise research and testing into clear, evidence-backed recommendations, narrowing from many ideas to a shortlist of the strongest concepts.

 - Present validated concepts to the Investment Committee (comprising decision-makers from our corporate backers and the Founders Factory CEO), making a compelling case for which ventures to greenlight.

 - Collaborate across the studio — working with other Venture Designers, Venture Builders, investors, and functional specialists — to sharpen your thinking and leverage collective expertise.

 - Stay close to emerging technologies, tools, and market shifts so you're always bringing fresh thinking to each sprint.



What We're Looking For

 - Proven experience in 0→1 concept development, venture design, or similar roles where you've taken ideas from fuzzy opportunity spaces through to validated propositions — ideally across multiple industries or verticals.

 - Strong strategic thinking combined with a bias for action. You can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to run a scrappy experiment in the same afternoon.

 - Deep comfort with market research and competitive analysis. You know how to find signal in noise and develop a point of view on where a market is going.

 - Experience designing and running rapid experiments (A/B tests, landing page tests, concierge MVPs, user interviews) to validate assumptions with real users.

 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills. You'll need to present complex findings and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders with diverse backgrounds.

 - A curious, creative mind that also brings discipline — you generate lots of ideas but know how to prioritise ruthlessly based on evidence.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and pace. The sprint format means things move fast and the brief is often wide open. That excites you, not intimidates you.



Nice to Have

 - Fluency in German language 

 - Background in innovation or a venture studio/builder environment.

 - Experience working with or alongside corporate partners and navigating stakeholder dynamics.

 - Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools (Figma, no-code/low-code platforms) to bring concepts to life quickly.

 - Understanding of business model design and unit economics at the concept stage.

 - Experience across multiple sectors (fintech, healthtech, sustainability, consumer, etc.).



What We Offer

 - The chance to shape ventures from the very beginning — the concepts you validate become real companies.

 - A collaborative, high-energy studio environment surrounded by builders, investors, and operators.

 - Exposure to a diverse range of industries and corporate partners.

 - Desk space in our London office with a fully-serviced workspace.

 - Support across marketing, legal, finance, fundraising, growth, and recruitment.

 - Competitive salary and benefits package.

postings.title: Co-Found with Founders Factory - Healthcare Studio
postings.description:
Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high growth companies. We have created the fastest way to build a successful startup. We specialise in building founding teams, developing disruptive concepts, finding your first customer, and raising your first round. We know that starting and growing a business is hard so we’ve designed the people, processes, and platform to remove as much friction as possible.



The Opportunity:

Health systems globally are burdened by capacity constraints, rising chronic disease, aging populations, and escalating operational costs. Care delivery models built around physical hospitals are increasingly unsustainable. Advances in connected devices, remote diagnostics, and AI-enabled monitoring now make it possible to safely move large parts of care beyond hospital walls while improving outcomes and patient experience.

The big promise of technology in this space is to enable continuous, proactive, and lower cost care particularly across long-term condition management or home-based / community care while allowing scarce clinical resources to focus where they matter most.

We are looking for exceptional entrepreneurs passionate about building the future of healthcare delivery. Whether you’re a healthtech founder post-exit looking for your next venture, an operator who’s scaled a business from the inside and is ready to build your own, or a researcher aiming to commercialise your work, Founders Factory is the world's best cofounder.

Our areas of focus:

 - Connected Skilled Nursing Facilities OS

 - Post-Discharge Recovery Intelligence

 - Smart Hospital Asset Intelligence Layer

 - Clinical Coding Revenue Intelligence

 - Hospital Discharge Readiness Engine

 - Digital Biomarkers for Paediatric Neurodivergence

 - Cognitive Decline Early Detection + Caregiver Platform

 - Rapid Deploy Clinical Infrastructure



What’s in it for me?

 - Co-found a company with Founders Factory’s team of IPO-exited founders and experienced operators

 - A validated problem space and early venture thesis

 - Access to a team of senior operators across product, engineering, data and growth.

 - Support from a Venture Builder, someone who can help build and validate quickly

 - Unlock pre-seed investment of €275k spin out capital

 - Join our 6-month venture build and acceleration programme

 - Access to the Founders Factory ecosystem, network and investors

 - Collaborate with industry-leading corporates, including healthcare system partners

postings.title: Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation
postings.description:
FOUNDING LEAD ENGINEER — AI & WORKFLOW AUTOMATION

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and leading companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, we combine early-stage capital with a hands-on Venture Studio team across product, engineering, growth, talent and fundraising.

We’re now building a new venture tackling one of Germany’s biggest labour-market challenges: how to find, engage and hire skilled workers at scale.

We’re looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer with founder ambitions to build the first product from scratch, with the opportunity to become the venture’s Technical Co-Founder.


THE OPPORTUNITY

Recruiting skilled workers is still remarkably manual. Candidates are found across fragmented channels, contacted via WhatsApp or phone, qualified one by one, matched against roles and repeatedly chased for missing information.

We believe a large part of this workflow can be fundamentally redesigned using AI, conversational interfaces and automation.

You would build the first version: from candidate acquisition and qualification to matching, follow-up and integrations into existing recruiting workflows.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong full-stack engineer able to build independently from zero to working product

 - Experience automating messy, real-world workflows

 - Hands-on experience shipping LLM / AI-agent functionality to users

 - Comfortable connecting APIs, databases, messaging tools and third-party systems

 - Product-minded: you care about whether technology actually removes work and improves conversion

 - High ownership and entrepreneurial ambition — whether as a founder, early engineer, freelancer or technical operator

 - Familiarity with the DACH market; German strongly preferred


PARTICULARLY RELEVANT

Experience with recruitment or HR tech, ATS/CRM integrations, WhatsApp, voice AI, n8n/Make, matching systems, marketplaces or workflow-heavy SaaS would be highly relevant.




WHAT WE OFFER

You’ll build the company from day one with capital and hands-on support from Founders Factory, working alongside an experienced venture team and with access to our network of founders, operators, corporate partners and investors.

This is an opportunity to build first, validate quickly and potentially step in as Technical Co-Founder of an independent venture-backed company.

postings.title: Venture Builder (HealthTech)
postings.description:

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. 💪 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Owning the end-to-end early build: from problem definition and MVP scoping through to shipping, testing, and iteration

 - Getting products into users hands fast, using lean, experimental approaches to validate assumptions and generate learning

 - Shaping the customer experience and product vision, balancing user needs with commercial and technical realities

 - Working closely with founders to challenge thinking, sharpen focus, and drive momentum, especially when things feel unclear or uncomfortable

 - Helping ventures progress through studio stage gates, supporting founders towards strong, evidence-backed IC decisions

 - Spotting opportunities early by staying close to market dynamics, emerging tech, and real user behaviour

 - Communicating clearly and regularly, sharing progress, learnings, trade-offs, and recommendations with founders and the wider studio




🎯 REQUIRED SKILLS, EXPERIENCE AND MINDSET:

 - Demonstrated 0→1 experience in digital health or medtech, whether at a startup, through a side project, research, or volunteering (experience applying AI or developing innovative health/medical devices are considered highly advantageous). 

 - Driving momentum by subscribing to lean methodologies and an experimental approach, you prioritise speed, learning, and focus over perfection

 - Comfortable wearing multiple hats (product, design, tech, growth) and knowing when to pull in specialist support

 - Strong technical mindset, with the ability to build no-code / low-code solutions, prototypes, or proofs of concept to accelerate validation

 - Commercially curious with the ability to think about ICPs, value propositions, pricing hypotheses, and early GTM alongside product

 - Communicating your ideas, progress and learnings to the team, seeking feedback when needed.

 - Comfortable setting expectations and ways of working with founders, and maintaining strong, honest working relationships




👌 WE VALUE PEOPLE WHO:

 - Thrive in ambiguity and enjoy solving messy problems

 - Quick thinking and intuition, someone who can balance creativity with objective data

 - A passion for creating products people love, caring about product performance is key

 - The ability to adapt and operate in an ambiguous environment

 - Comfortable with taking calculated risks and learning fast

 - Wanting to continuously improve your skills and productivity, challenging yourself when you can

 - Strong leadership that drives outcomes

 - Being approachable and optimistic




🚫 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not a pure designer or engineer

 - Not a consultant writing decks from the sidelines

 - Not a 9–5 role



This role is about building, deciding, testing, and moving. This is a fast-moving venture studio environment where momentum matters and timelines can be intense at key moments. Please if you like the sound of a 12 month contract and you've built products from scratch before (yourself).

Note - Sloppy/Lazy AI applications will be rejected.

postings.title: Founder & CEO | Robotics (HealthCare)
postings.description:
FOUNDER & CEO — NIGHTWATCH

One robot. One floor. One job. The automation layer for US senior living

Location: United States

Start date: ASAP

More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1dgHLTatvXucNpAfXNcYlwpFQoyzIOAAwv5xnHv95vkE/edit?slide=id.p1#slide=id.p1

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with a leading global industrial technology partner, we are building a new portfolio of ventures.




ABOUT THE VENTURE

America's ~1,900 continuing-care retirement communities (CCRCs) are the only elder-care buyers whose model rewards keeping residents healthier for longer: residents join at 75–80, pay a large entry fee (avg. ~$402k) plus $12–30k a month, and the community carries the lifetime cost of care. These campuses staff their night shifts at roughly twice the regulatory minimum — comfort-driven cover that can't simply be cut — and once holidays, sickness and cover are loaded, each night position carries ~$160k of true annual cost. Worse, the status quo causes the harm it exists to prevent: around 80% of falls happen in the window right after a nurse's check wakes the resident. Existing tech — pull cords, wearables, fixed sensors — is safety kit that never changes the staffing model.

We are building NightWatch: a mobile UWB-radar robot that patrols the corridor at night, senses through doors and walls, and reports movement as fact — in bed, out of bed, in the bathroom, on the floor — never as clinical judgement. Data is monitored remotely, and staff are alerted only when a physical check is warranted. No cameras. No wearables. No per-room installation. Sold as robot-as-a-service, it delivers a two-to-three-month payback and is the easiest pilot in the category to say yes to: zero capex, zero installation, nothing entering residents' rooms, and fully reversible.




OUR OFFER

We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start:

 - The programme runs in two phases:
   
   Months 0–6 (Build)
   
   - $128k ring-fenced build budget to cover founder stipends and additional specialist resource at the founders' discretion
   
   - Founder stipends are $6,675 per founder per month, drawn from this budget
   
   - Embedded studio team throughout: a full time venture builder, with support from a broader team consisting of a studio lead and growth marketer. Founders build; the Studio supports.
   
   - On-demand access to specialist support across data science, applied AI, fundraising, legal, finance, PR and commercial partnerships
   
   - Dedicated network access from day one
   
   Months 6–12 (Accelerator / Spinout)
   
   - At incorporation, the founding team will receive 70% equity in a new company set up for the venture, and the Studio 15%, both subscribed at nominal value. The remaining 15% is reserved as an employee option pool.
   
   - $320k cash investment goes directly into the new venture's bank account at IC approval - full founder discretion over how funds are deployed
   
   - Accelerator support: a dedicated squad covering growth, product and fundraising, plus continued access to shared services


JOBS TO BE DONE

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

 - Define the wedge. Choose the operator profile and the 3-state cluster (consistent regulation) where you run concurrent pilots first.

 - Turn a thesis into a product. Work with our partner's robotics teams to take the night-patrol robot and its remote-monitoring layer from concept to a fleet operators can run.

 - Win the first pilots. Land 2–3 CCRC / senior-living operators and prove FTE substitution through the pilot sequence — service level held with one less night headcount.

 - Sell savings, not safety. Frame the buy as an ROI decision for the CFO/COO, positioned as redeployment, not redundancy.

 - Drive the economics. Push the robots-to-operator ratio toward the levels that make margins trend to software, working with our partner on a path to lower unit cost.

 - Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the automation layer for senior living.


YOUR IDEAL EXPERIENCE

We are not looking for a traditional senior-living executive or a pure robotics researcher. The ideal candidate sits at the intersection.

 - Deep familiarity with at least one buyer segment: US senior living / CCRC operators, eldercare, or enterprise facilities operations.

 - Enterprise commercial instinct: you can navigate multi-site operator sales cycles and turn a pilot into a fleet rollout.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity: shaping the product, defining the buyer, and making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

 - Credibility with conservative care operators and forward-looking venture investors, and willingness to be on the ground in the US.

 - Experience integrating hardware / robotics products into healthcare and/or medical care is considered highly advantageous

Most importantly, you are motivated by category creation — building the operational backbone for how America ages, on robots you put there first.



This is your company. We're here to help.

postings.title: Talent Investor - Venture Studio
postings.description:
ABOUT FOUNDERS FACTORY:

Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator. We build technology companies from scratch, working with leading corporate partners to identify opportunities, develop new products and businesses, and build the founding teams that turn them into independent companies.

Unlike a traditional VC, we don't just invest in companies that already exist. We help create them. That means our approach to talent is different too. We believe the right founder can fundamentally change the trajectory of a company.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Talent Investor, you'll sit at the intersection of venture, talent and company building, helping us identify the exceptional people who will build our next generation of companies.

Our ventures often start with a problem or opportunity, rather than a founder. Your job is to find the person who can turn that opportunity into an excellent business.

You'll work closely with our Venture Builders, Studio Leads and founders to:

 - Identify exceptional founders across our global network and beyond.

 - Build talent maps and develop a point of view on where the best founders and operators sit.

 - Assess individuals for founder-market fit, looking beyond CVs and conventional credentials to understand their potential to build a company.

 - Build relationships with exceptional people who aren't necessarily looking for their next role.

 - Convince them to take the leap into entrepreneurship and build with Founders Factory.

 - Help founders identify and recruit their early founding team across product, technology, commercial and growth.

 - Develop our approach to founder sourcing, assessment and talent intelligence as we build more ventures.

This isn't traditional recruitment. You won't be given a list of vacancies to fill. You'll be given venture theses and asked to work out who could build them.

You'll have significant autonomy to experiment with how we identify, assess and attract exceptional people, and your work will directly influence the quality and trajectory of the companies we build.




ABOUT YOU

At your core, you're obsessed with exceptional people and curious about how great companies are built.

You might come from VC, executive search, strategy consulting, investment banking, a high-growth startup, venture building or talent. You don't need to have worked in venture before.

What matters is that you can:

 - Spot exceptional people and develop a strong point of view on their potential.

 - Understand businesses, markets and what makes founders successful.

 - Build genuine relationships and influence people to make high-stakes career decisions.

 - Source talent creatively, particularly people who aren't actively looking.

 - Operate with limited information, ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy.

 - Balance instinct with evidence and be willing to change your mind.

 - Move quickly without compromising your judgement.

 - Communicate clearly and challenge assumptions when needed.

You don't need to be a founder or have a traditional career path. We care more about your judgement, curiosity, ambition and ability to identify exceptional people.




WHAT YOU'LL BE MEASURED ON

 - Founder quality: Exceptional founders joining our ventures.

 - Founder-market fit: The quality of our decisions around who should build which company.

 - Speed: Moving from venture thesis to founder commitment quickly.

 - Founding teams: Helping founders build the teams they need to succeed.

 - Talent intelligence: Building a proprietary network and understanding of exceptional founders and operators.

 - Repeatability: Making our approach to talent investing better and more scalable over time.




A CAREER IN VENTURE

Talent Investing sits at the intersection of people, company building and venture capital.

You'll develop an investor's perspective on founders and companies at the earliest possible stage, often before there is a company to invest in.

Over time, there is scope to develop into broader venture-building and investment responsibilities across Founders Factory, depending on your performance, interests and the needs of the business.




OUR CULTURE

Working at Founders Factory is very different from working at a traditional company. We are resilient business builders, passionate about what we're creating and comfortable operating in uncertainty.

We:

 - Think big, act small, move fast

 - Value momentum over perfection

 - Embrace uncertainty and remain decisive

 - Suggest solutions, not problems

 - Prioritise diversity to strengthen our collective intelligence

 - Are polite, generous and show empathy to others




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary

 - Shares in the Founders Factory global portfolio

 - Hybrid working — typically Tuesdays and Thursdays in the London office

 - Up to 5 weeks working abroad each year

 - 25 days annual leave

 - 1 additional mental health day per quarter

 - Monthly calendar freedom day

 - Travel opportunities across our global Founders Factory offices

 - Access to our network of founders, investors, operators and corporate partners

Founders Factory is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where people can authentically be themselves, challenge assumptions, take risks and think creatively.

postings.title: Founding Engineer - Ambient Care Startup
postings.description:
Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity




ABOUT SUBTLE

Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until it became a crisis. We're building ambient sensing for the elderly and vulnerable at home, technology that quietly looks out for the people we love without asking them to wear anything or change how they live. We're early. We're validating with real customers, building the first hardware, and looking for the person who'll help turn this from an idea into a product families can trust with something this personal.


We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European technology partner. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team.



THE ROLE

You'll be our first engineering hire, working directly with the founder(s) and carrying real authority over what we build and how. It's a hands-on role that spans hardware and software, and a leadership one too, since you'll grow the team that follows you.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own hardware validation and bench testing end to end, and lead our manufacturing path. Whether that ends up being an outsourced partner or in-house, you're the one validating the sensor platform yourself and making sure whatever we ship has been properly tested before it reaches someone's home. This is safety-relevant, so you'd rather catch a failure on the bench than have it happen in someone's home.

 - Build the software that turns sensor data into something useful. Detection logic, alerting, and the escalation decisions that sit behind them, tested and monitored with the same rigor as the hardware.

 - Navigate the regulatory and security requirements that come with this territory. Certification requirements for embedded systems (software and hardware), and data protection for Personally Identifiable Information (PII), from day one rather than retrofitted later.

 - Grow the team. As we scale past this hire, you'll hire, mentor and lead the engineers who join under you.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have's

 - Early-stage hardware experience. You've taken a hardware product from 0 to 1 in a startup environment, and you're comfortable spanning embedded systems and software.

 - Experience using AI to accelerate how you work, across engineering, prototyping, and the day-to-day operations of running a startup.

postings.title: Tech Cofounder / CTO - PreSeed Solar Tech (FaiSabai)
postings.description:
Build the operating system for residential solar in Thailand, just as up to a million homes get ready to go solar

Location: Bangkok (Thailand-based, or willing to relocate)

Start date: ASAP

Role: Tech Co-Founder, alongside commercial co-founder in place

More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1-wg42oWaURTsW8EsBJs8CseedO92lJrrXJo7fNj1G_E/edit?slide=id.h5e9d9ad1d0be94e5_1_0#slide=id.h5e9d9ad1d0be94e5_1_0




ABOUT FOUNDERS FACTORY

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with ExpresSo NB, a corporate venture arm of PTT — Thailand's national energy company, we are building a new portfolio of climate ventures out of Bangkok.




ABOUT THE VENTURE

Thailand is about to have a residential solar boom. In August 2026 the government announced a ฿50,000 non-repayable grant per household, plus GSB and GH Bank soft loans, targeting 500,000 to 1 million homes on 5 kW rooftop systems. The market was already growing 22% a year before the subsidy.



The problem is everything around the panel. Homeowners are making a ฿150,000–340,000 technical decision blind. Air conditioning, the biggest load in nearly every home, runs after dark, so a system without storage generates while the house is empty. Exported power earns ฿2.20 against ฿4.00 retail, so a well-sized system matters more than a big one. And nobody is accountable for the saving: the installer quotes a number and leaves. On the supply side, roughly 2,500 mostly sub-scale installers have no way to absorb the volume. They design by hand, wait weeks for bank disbursement, and buy hardware at retail.



We are building FaiSabai: the operating system for residential solar in Thailand. A homeowner sends their bill on LINE. FaiSabai sizes the system from real consumption, adds a battery where the load needs one, and bundles grant, soft loan and an accredited installer into one contract. The household owns the asset from day one. A home monitoring device then verifies the promised saving and shifts controllable load into the generation window. Installers get qualified leads, design and quoting software, hardware at network prices, and payment on completion.



Nobody in Thailand sells an owned system with a managed outcome today. The reference models, 1KOMMA5° in Germany, Omnidian in the US and SolarSquare in India, are not live here. The sector has already shown it can scale: ION Energy reached 110 MW and 3,000+ installs a year before Bangkok Cable acquired it in April 2026.



Early validation: a landing-page test generated leads at ฿467 each, and homeowner interviews showed people want to own the system, fear being scammed, and want accreditation they can trust. The data and software layer is what makes FaiSabai defensible, and that is what you will build.




THE ROLE

You join Sirapat, FaiSabai's technical co-founder, to build the company. You own the product, platform, home monitoring and data. Sirapat owns demand and partners. Together you cover the whole business.

This is a full-time, fully committed founding role.




OUR OFFER

FaiSabai runs on an accelerator model: you build with the security of a national energy group behind you, and the speed and support of a venture studio around you.

 - Employed by ExpresSo NB: You are employed and paid by ExpresSo NB as co-founder. Package and any equity to be discussed.

 - Funded from day one: Go-to-market and operating costs come from ExpresSo NB's budget, so you spend your time building, not fundraising for runway.

 - Expert team: Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, growth, data, design, legal, hiring and more.

 - Accelerator: Deep operational support on growth, product and fundraising, plus access to Founders Factory's investor network.

 - Validation: A vetted concept with homeowner interviews, a lead-generation test, a financial model and operator interviews from Singapore, the Philippines and Germany already done.




JOBS TO BE DONE

As technical co-founder, you will turn FaiSabai from a validated concept into the platform Thai homes and installers run on.

 - Ship the homeowner journey. Build the flow from "send your bill on LINE" to system design, saving forecast, funding and installation tracking, and get it into the hands of real households.

 - Build the installer stack. Design and quoting software that turns hand-drawn load sizing, single-line diagrams and savings forecasts into minutes of work, plus the tools that run leads, procurement and payment on completion.

 - Make the savings real. Choose, integrate and deploy the home monitoring device. Prove actual savings land within 10% of the forecast, and push self-consumption above 65% by shifting load into the generation window.

 - Own the data. Turn hourly load data from Thai homes into better sizing, sharper forecasts and a dataset no generic irradiance model can match.

 - Build toward the VPP. Architect monitoring and control so a growing fleet of homes, batteries and EV chargers can join demand response and a virtual power plant.

 - Hit the pilot gates. Help take FaiSabai from 10–20 homes to 100, then 1,000, against clear thresholds on cost to acquire, saving, install time and NPS.

 - Build the team. Hire and lead the engineering and product team, and set the technical bar for the company.




YOUR IDEAL EXPERIENCE

We are not looking for a pure software engineer or a solar salesperson. The ideal candidate is a technical builder who knows how Thai homes buy solar.

 - You have sold solar to Thai households, or worked with installers, and understand how residential solar is sold and installed.

 - You have built and shipped a product end to end, platform and app, with real users.

 - You have connected-energy or IoT experience: home energy management, inverter or battery monitoring, smart meters or EV charging.

 - You understand energy data and the grid well enough to build toward VPP and demand response.

 - You have a 0→1 track record, and have hired and led an engineering team.

 - You complement a commercial co-founder: you own product and tech while Sirapat owns demand and partners.

 - You are Thailand-based, or willing to be. Thai speaker strongly preferred.

 - You are full-time and fully committed.



Bonus: you have worked at a home-energy platform or solar installer, in Thailand, Southeast Asia or globally.

Most importantly, you want to make sure every Thai home that goes solar gets the saving it was promised, and build the platform that does it.

This is your company. We're here to help.

postings.title: Fractional Chief Medical Officer  - Tricorder Systems
postings.description:
FRACTIONAL CHIEF MEDICAL OFFICER — PROJECT TRICORDER

We're looking for a clinician who has served as a military medic to be Tricorder's clinical lead and the medical name behind the product. You'll shape clinical workflows, protect patient safety, help to roadmap clinical device regulation, giving the product credibility with clinicians, defence customers and investors.




ABOUT PROJECT TRICORDER - HTTPS://WWW.TRICORDER-SYSTEMS.COM/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.



Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next.

Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway.



What you'll do

You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe.

 - Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios.

 - Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. Advise on the evidence needed for the medical device and regulatory pathway.

 - Be the medical face of the product: put your clinical name to Tricorder. Represent it to defence medical services, NHS and ambulance trusts, humanitarian organisations and investors, and help the founder carry the clinical story in pitches and pilots.

 - Open doors: use your network across defence medicine, the NHS and humanitarian response to secure clinical pilots, user testing and early design partners.

 - Guide clinical evidence: help design pilots and early studies, and review clinical claims, protocols and terminology across the product and its AI features.

 - Advise the team: be a sounding board for the founder and build team on clinical priorities. Help with clinical hiring as the company grows.




WHO YOU ARE




MUST-HAVES

 - You've served as a military medic or doctor. This is non-negotiable. You know operational medicine first-hand, from point-of-injury care to the field hospital.

 - A GMC-registered doctor with deep experience in resuscitation, trauma or emergency surgery, emergency medicine, or pre-hospital care.

 - Still active clinically, whether as a reservist, in the NHS, or in humanitarian or disaster response.

 - You're credible with senior defence medical leaders, NHS clinicians and investors, and comfortable being the named clinical lead for a product.

 - You can turn clinical reality into clear, practical product decisions, and you're happy working with engineers and designers at startup pace.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience advising or working with medtech or health-tech startups, ideally as a CMO, clinical lead or advisor.

 - Clinical Safety Officer training (DCB0129/DCB0160), or experience with medical device regulation (UKCA/CE, ISO 14971).

 - Leadership roles in defence medical services, such as a clinical lead, medical director or command role.

 - Experience with mass-casualty planning, deployed hospital care, or global health systems.

 - Familiarity with clinical AI, data standards or digital health interoperability.


PROBABLY NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You haven't served in a military medical role.

 - You're looking for a passive advisory title without hands-on involvement in the product.

postings.title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
postings.description:
PROJECT TRICORDER — CLINICAL INFRASTRUCTURE FOR FIELD OPERATIONS

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.




ABOUT PROJECT TRICORDER - HTTPS://WWW.TRICORDER-SYSTEMS.COM/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype  product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language  models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.




1. DATA PIPELINE AND EVALUATION HARNESS

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

 - Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

 - Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

 - Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

 - Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

 - Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.


2. CLINICAL KNOWLEDGE BASE

Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.

 - Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

 - Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.

 - Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.

 - Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.

 - Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.

By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.




MUST-HAVES

 - Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.

 - Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.

 - Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.

 - Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.

 - Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.

 - Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.

 - Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.

 - A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.

 - Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).

 - Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.

 - Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.

 - Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.


PROBABLY NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF

 - You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.

 - You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.



This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

postings.title: CTO Cofounder - PreSeed PropTech Berlin
postings.description:
FOUNDERS FACTORY × NUA MATERIALS



Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory baut und finanziert gemeinsam mit außergewöhnlichen Gründer:innen und führenden Unternehmen neue Start-ups; unser Gründerteam verfügt über eigene Exit-/IPO-Erfahrung, und unsere mehr als 300 Portfoliounternehmen haben seit 2015 über 900 Mio. USD an Anschlussfinanzierung eingeworben.

Für Nua Materials suchen wir eine:n technische:n Co-Founder & CTO, der oder die gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Gründer aus einem validierten Konzept ein skalierbares Produkt und Unternehmen aufbaut.




DIE CHANCE

Neuartige und nachhaltige Baustoffe gibt es längst, doch viele schaffen den Weg in reale Bauprojekte nur langsam. Für Bauunternehmen, Wohnungsunternehmen und Projektentwickler sind Informationen und Nachweise fragmentiert, Produkte schwer vergleichbar und neue Materialien mit zusätzlichen technischen, wirtschaftlichen und organisatorischen Risiken verbunden. Gleichzeitig steigt der regulatorische Druck: Wesentliche Teile der neuen EU-Bauprodukteverordnung gelten seit 2026, der Digitale Produktpass für Bauprodukte kommt.

Viele bestehende Lösungen setzen bei Dokumentation, Nachweisen und Zertifizierung an – nicht bei der eigentlichen Auswahl- und Kaufentscheidung. Genau dort setzt Nua Materials an. Ein zentraler Baustein ist der Nua Score, der bereits in einer ersten Version vorliegt. Bisherige Gespräche mit Herstellern, Bauunternehmen, Projektentwicklern und Gebäudeeigentümern bestätigen den Bedarf und zeigen Interesse an Pilotprojekten.




WAS DU AUFBAUEN WIRST

Als Co-Founder & CTO verantwortest du in der frühen Phase Produkt und Technologie.

 - Du definierst mit Nutzer:innen die entscheidenden Abläufe und baust den ersten nutzbaren Prototypen.

 - Du entwickelst den Nua Score weiter und baust eine robuste Daten- und Systemarchitektur für unterschiedliche externe Datenquellen.

 - Du entscheidest, was jetzt gebaut, später ergänzt oder automatisiert werden sollte – und was bewusst nicht ins Produkt gehört.

 - Du arbeitest direkt mit ersten Kund:innen und Partnern und baust später ein kleines Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam auf.

Die ersten Monate sind sehr operativ: Wir suchen eine:n technische:n Gründer:in, der oder die selbst baut und Produktentscheidungen mitträgt.




WEN WIR SUCHEN

 - Produktentwicklung: Du kannst aus einem noch unscharfen Kundenproblem einen klaren, testbaren Produktansatz entwickeln und technisch umsetzen.

 - Datenbasierte Produkte: Du hast Erfahrung mit datengetriebenen Plattformen, Bewertungs- oder Vergleichssystemen und kannst konkrete Fehlerquellen, Datenqualitätsprobleme und Validierungsentscheidungen beschreiben.

 - Technische Breite: Du bist stark in Backend und Datenarchitektur und kommst im Frontend weit genug, um frühe Produktversionen selbst auszuliefern.

 - Vertrauen im B2B: Du baust nachvollziehbare Systeme, die bei risikoaversen Unternehmenskunden, langen Entscheidungswegen und hohen Nachweisanforderungen bestehen.

 - Gründermentalität und Marktverständnis: Du hast gegründet, warst eine:r der ersten technischen Mitarbeiter:innen eines Start-ups oder hast vergleichbare Verantwortung übernommen. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, professionelles Englisch und Erfahrung im DACH-Markt sind wichtig.


BESONDERS INTERESSANT, ABER KEIN MUSS

 - Erfahrung in Construction Tech oder PropTech

 - Hintergrund in Bauingenieurwesen oder Materialwissenschaften, idealerweise mit LCA-/EPD-Erfahrung

 - Erfahrung mit Vergleichsplattformen oder Marktplätzen


WAS WIR BIETEN

 - Kapital und Gründerfinanzierung für die Aufbauphase

 - Enge Unterstützung durch Founders Factory in Produkt, Daten, Wachstum, Finanzierung, Recht und Personal – auf Basis bestehender Markt-, Kunden- und Produktarbeit

 - Zugang zu ersten potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Bau- und Wohnungswirtschaft sowie zu unserem internationalen Netzwerk



-------------------
In English: 



FOUNDERS FACTORY × NUA MATERIALS

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.

For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.




THE OPPORTUNITY

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. A core component is the Nua Score, which already exists in an initial version. Conversations with manufacturers, construction companies, developers and asset owners have confirmed the need and shown interest in pilots.




WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.

 - Define the critical workflows with users and build the first usable product.

 - Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.

 - Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.

 - Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.

The first months will be highly hands-on: we are looking for a technical founder who builds personally and helps shape the product, not a CTO who starts by delegating.




WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Product development: You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear, testable product approach and build it.

 - Data-driven products: You have experience with data-heavy platforms, scoring or comparison systems and can talk concretely about failure modes, data-quality issues and validation decisions you have encountered.

 - Technical range: You are strong in backend and data architecture and capable enough on the frontend to ship early product versions yourself.

 - Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

 - Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.


ESPECIALLY RELEVANT, BUT NOT REQUIRED

 - Experience in ConTech or PropTech

 - Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience

 - Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Capital and founder funding for the build phase

 - Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work

 - Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

Turn Thailand's burned rice straw into verified carbon removal, with ExpresSo NB's rails behind you from day one

Location: Bangkok, with regular time in the rice belt (Isan, Central Plains). Open to candidates based elsewhere in Thailand.

Start date: ASAP. Final founder pitches to the ExpresSo NB board and Founders Factory decision makers in early December 2026.

Role: Founder & CEO

More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/111GRCiHMbWQ7Mhp7clu6eVj9I5Fe0torULSBbQIbjHo/edit?slide=id.h1680521e6288a2b8_0_990#slide=id.h1680521e6288a2b8_0_990




ABOUT FOUNDERS FACTORY

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with ExpresSo NB, a corporate venture arm of PTT — Thailand's national energy company, we are building a new portfolio of climate ventures out of Bangkok.




ABOUT THE VENTURE

Every dry season, Thailand's sky turns grey. Around 4.8 million tonnes of rice straw are burned in the fields each year, and biomass burning drives 25–30% of dry-season PM2.5 in the Bangkok region. Farmers burn because it is the fastest, cheapest way to clear a field. The straw is not worthless; nobody has built the route to market.

Meanwhile, the world's biggest buyers of carbon removal are queuing for supply. Biochar was 89.4% of all delivered durable carbon removal in Q2 2025, over 90% of industrial supply is already contracted, and credits average around $160/t. Buyers like Microsoft have confirmed the price; what they need is a new, credible origin with proof of where every tonne came from.



We are building Amber: the logistics and verification platform that routes agricultural residue from the field edge to conversion capacity, and owns the chain of custody that turns scattered smallholder activity into premium carbon credits. Satellite mapping finds the residue before harvest. A smartphone app runs booking, weighing, routing and farmer payment, and generates the audit-grade record buyers require as a by-product. Credits issue through Puro.earth http://Puro.earth, Isometric and Thailand's Premium T-VER, with physical biochar sold as soil amendment at home and exported to premium markets such as Japan.



The timing is right. Since 1 April 2026, farmers who burn lose access to government disaster relief and agricultural support, with fields monitored by satellite. Cabinet approved the draft Climate Change Act in December 2025, setting up an ETS, a carbon tax and a regulated credit market. Pyrolysis hardware is now off the shelf.



Early validation is strong. Rice farmers told us they want free field clearance first and income second. A baling contractor in Thung Kula said the only question is "whether the company will actually do it." That's where you come in.




OUR OFFER

We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start:

 - Capital and backing: Tranche 1: €110k yours to spend, plus a full-time venture builder and a hands-on squad around you. Tranche 2: €175k of spin-out capital plus a 6-month accelerator programme, with ExpresSo NB as strategic backer from day one.

 - Expert team: Hands-on support across product, growth, fundraising, AI/ML, design, legal, hiring and more.

 - MVP build: Full-time venture builder(s) to help ship the first product: supply register, dispatch and the field app.

 - Accelerator: 6 months of deep operational support post-launch.

 - Strategic network: Intros to top-tier investors, carbon buyers and registries, and Founders Factory's global corporate partners.

 - Validation: A vetted concept with buyer, farmer, baler and offtaker interviews already done, so you start at month six, not month zero.




JOBS TO BE DONE

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into Southeast Asia's leading carbon removal supply chain.

 - Pick the first district. Decide which province, crop and harvest window you attack first, using satellite residue maps and burn-scar history, and secure contracted feedstock before anyone buys a machine.

 - Win the farmer, the baler and the mill. Build trust on the ground with farmers, baling contractors, village heads and mills. Make clearing a field with Amber easier and better paid than burning it.

 - Move real tonnes. Run Phase 1 as a broker: buy residue, route it through contracted balers and trucks, deliver it to biochar producers, and learn the true cost per tonne by distance.

 - Turn tonnes into credits. Partner with producers on digital MRV, issue the first credits through Puro.earth http://Puro.earth, Isometric or T-VER, and sign forward offtake with global carbon buyers.

 - Build the company. Hire the founding team, raise capital, and establish Amber as the trusted name in Thai carbon removal, then take the model to rice, cane, cassava and maize across the region.




YOUR IDEAL EXPERIENCE

We are not looking for a carbon-markets consultant or a pure software founder. The ideal candidate has moved real tonnes in rural Thailand, and can sell what comes out the other end.

 - Founder or senior operator who has run a physical rural aggregation supply chain in Thailand at real volume: rice, sugar cane, cassava, palm, maize or biomass.

 - Relationships with farmers, cooperatives, baling contractors, mills or agri-processors, and the respect of people in the field, not just the boardroom.

 - B2B commercial instinct: you can sell industrial offtake, soil amendment into fertiliser distribution, or biomass into industry, and close long-term contracts.

 - Comfort with data and digital tools: you can reason about satellite data, dispatch apps and MRV even if you are not writing the code yourself. Exposure to carbon credits, biochar or climate tech is a strong plus.

 - Fluent Thai and strong English. You can run a meeting in a village in Isan in the morning and pitch a global carbon buyer in the afternoon.

 - Credibility with forward-looking venture investors; ready to stand in front of the ExpresSo NB board in December.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity: making irreversible calls with incomplete data, through mud, weather and harvest deadlines.



You might be a founder who has already built in agritech or climate, a supply chain leader from a sugar, rice or energy group ready to build your own company, or a returning Thai operator who wants to solve a problem you grew up with.

Most importantly, you want to be the person who ends field burning in Thailand, and builds a regional company doing it.

This is your company. We're here to help.

postings.title: Venture Builder - 6 months  (Bangkok)
postings.description:
VENTURE BUILDER - PROJECT AMBER (BANGKOK)

Contract: Initial 6-month freelance contract, with the possibility of extension

Rate: SGD 6,000 / month

Start: Immediate / Urgent

Location: Bangkok, with regular field time in the rice belt (Isan, Central Plains)

More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/111GRCiHMbWQ7Mhp7clu6eVj9I5Fe0torULSBbQIbjHo/edit?slide=id.h1680521e6288a2b8_0_990#slide=id.h1680521e6288a2b8_0_990

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with PTT, Thailand's national energy company, we are building a new portfolio of climate ventures out of Bangkok.




ABOUT THE VENTURE

Around 4.8 million tonnes of Thai rice straw are burned in the fields every year, driving 25–30% of dry-season PM2.5 in the Bangkok region. At the same time, global buyers are queuing for biochar carbon removal at around $160/t, and over 90% of industrial supply is already contracted. Nobody owns the route from the field to the buyer.

Amber is the logistics and verification platform that closes that gap. It maps residue by satellite, routes it through contracted balers and trucks to field-edge kilns and pyrolysis plants, and captures an audit-grade chain of custody, from GPS pickup to lab result to credit, so scattered smallholder activity becomes premium, verified carbon removal. Since April 2026, farmers who burn lose access to state support, so they now need a route for their residue.

Amber is backed by PTT, which brings logistics, rural reach, capital and offtake credibility that no standalone operator can rent. The plan is capex-light: broker first, toll second, own machinery last.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Venture Builder to help take Amber from validated concept to a working business in six months, alongside the founder and the Founders Factory studio team.

This is a build-first, high-ownership role. You'll own the early build: from sharpening the problem and scoping the MVP to running it in the field with real farmers, balers and kilns, and iterating fast. One week you'll be in a rice field in Isan with a baling contractor; the next you'll be mapping cost per tonne by distance or prototyping the dispatch app.

It is not a pure design or engineering role, not a consulting role, and not a 9–5.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Phase 1 build. Get Amber's broker model live: the plot map and supply register, dispatch for contracted balers and trucks, and a field app that captures GPS trace, load weights, moisture and photos.

 - Run lean experiments in the field. Test what farmers accept per rai, the true cost per tonne by distance, and how far the collection radius can stretch, against the November–January harvest window.

 - Build the ecosystem. Sign up the first farmers, baling contractors, mills and biochar producers, and find new char buyers for producers who are short on demand.

 - Lay the MRV foundations. Design the data trail, from residue baseline through pickup, kiln batch and lab result, that Phase 2 credits under Puro.earth http://Puro.earth, Isometric or Premium T-VER will depend on.

 - Shape the product and the farmer experience. Make booking, pricing and payment simple enough for a smallholder and robust enough for an auditor.

 - Support the founder through the studio gates. Prepare the evidence for stage-gate and investment decisions with Founders Factory and PTT, and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly.

 - Track the market. Keep a close eye on carbon credit prices, the burning ban, Thailand's Climate Change Act and competitors.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have experience in agritech, agri supply chains, logistics, climate tech or carbon markets, ideally in Thailand or Southeast Asia.

 - You are comfortable in the field: you can build trust with farmers, village heads, balers and mill operators, and enjoy being on the ground.

 - You can build low-code prototypes (dispatch tools, field data capture, simple dashboards) and think about go-to-market, pricing and unit economics.

 - You are at home with data: satellite or geospatial data, operational metrics, cost models. MRV or carbon credit experience is a strong plus.

 - You work comfortably across product, operations, design, tech and growth.

 - You speak fluent Thai and strong English.

 - You are based in Bangkok or ready to be, and can travel regularly to rural provinces.

 - You want to be part of a founding journey, and possibly to build your own company one day.




WHAT YOU GET

 - A front-row seat building a PTT-backed climate venture from day one

 - Hands-on support from the Founders Factory studio team across product, data, design, growth and fundraising

 - Real ownership of a business tackling one of Thailand's most visible problems

 - A global network of founders, operators and investors
